summary: Rallybio Corp filed an 8-K reporting termination of its March 1, 2026 merger agreement with Candid Therapeutics, Inc. after Candid terminated the deal to pursue a Permitted Alternative Agreement with UCB S.A. Rallybio is entitled to a $50,000,000 Parent Termination Fee and expense reimbursement. A waiver executed on May 1, 2026 released all claims among parties and allowed fee payment on the first business day post-termination. Rallybio intends to withdraw its S-4 registration statement. Watch for receipt of the termination fee and any potential shareholder litigation or strategic alternatives going forward.
